test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: 141 is divided into two parts in such a way that the one-eighth part of the first and one-ninth part of the second are in the ratio 5 : 6. Find the first part.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **(1/8)th of first part** to **(1/9)th of second part** = 5 : 6

Ratio of **First part (x)** to **Second part (y)** = (5 × 8) : (6 × 9) = 40 : 54 = 20 : 27

Total units = 20 + 27 = 47 units → 141

1 unit = 141 ÷ 47 = 3

**First part** = 20 units = 20 × 3 = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total sum = 141

Let the **First part** be x and the **Second part** be y.

Condition 1: x + y = 141

Condition 2: (x/8) : (y/9) = 5 : 6

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0c7ea2939010c108d8d207a67660052890b5aaf99ba020bf472d9508ed5daf8.png] 

From Condition 2:

⇒ (x/8) ÷ (y/9) = 5/6

⇒ (x/8) × (9/y) = 5/6

⇒ 9x / 8y = 5/6

⇒ x/y = (5 × 8) / (6 × 9)

⇒ x/y = 40 / 54 = 20 / 27

Now, divide 141 in the ratio 20 : 27:

⇒ First part (x) = [20 / (20 + 27)] × 141

⇒ x = (20 / 47) × 141

⇒ x = 20 × 3

⇒ x = 60

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Division Rule

To divide a quantity S in the ratio a : b, the first part is [a / (a + b)] × S and the second part is [b / (a + b)] × S.

Compound Ratio

The compound ratio of (a : b) and (c : d) is (ac : bd). In this problem, we converted the fractions into a simplified integer ratio.

Proportionality

If a/b = c/d, then it is a simple proportion. Here, we used the cross-multiplication method to isolate the ratio of variables x and y.</p
